summary: Add auth import-file, status and logout so listing detail requests can carry a browser session's redfin.com cookies.
reason: Redfin blocks /stingray/api/home/details/initialInfo with HTTP 403 for requests without a browser-earned session (issue #698), and no header change gets past it.
validated_outcome: Parser, host-guard and dry-run redaction unit tests pass. Not yet checked against a live Redfin session.
